Name: Symmetrical Shed
Author: Xrac
Description:
Just a very simple texture edit to the shed exterior so that the door is centered thus achieving the symmetrical goodness we all crave.

Installation: extract the file to */Content/Buildings and overwrite Shed.xnb when prompted.
